ValidationRule.description: Checks if the Close date is a future date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Commercial_Opportunity', CloseDate <= TODAY(), (ISCHANGED( CloseDate ) || ISNEW()), NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Close Date must be a future date
